INNER MOUTH. [12] [Dor.]
Violent heat ; severe pain across kidneys, < by pressure and motion ; full, hard pulse ; face red and bloated ; staring eyes ; constipation and retention of urine. θ Parotitis.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Dor.]
Nausea and vomiting.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Dor.]
Nausea, at times vomiting ; faint feeling ; very tired ; trembling in all her limbs, especially hands ; cramp-like constriction in pit of stomach ; stools hard ; difficult, painful urination. θ Gastric derangement.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Dor.]
Stools hard. θ Gastric derangement.
Dysentery, with intense pain in rectum.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Dor.]
Difficult urination.
Dysuria, with burning, stinging pain.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Dor.]
Itching and burning in glans penis, which is swollen and bluish-red ; urethra inflamed, with excruciating pain, especially when urinating. θ Gonorrhœa.
Gleet and gonorrhœa.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Dor.]
Pain in back, in lumbar region.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Dor.]
Great trembling in extremities. θ Gastric derangement.
   

NERVES. [36] [Dor.]
Great trembling in extremities. θ Gastric derangement.
